description: Supply brand, navigation, and optional actions once. Below the breakpoint, SiteHeader automatically adds a hamburger to the right of the logo (mirrored in RTL) and presents the same navigation in a full-height, scrollable drawer with a dark backdrop. It handles focus, Escape, outside press, link selection, and page scroll locking. Applications supply links and routing; no menu slot, duplicate links, IDs, or drawer wiring are needed. Before JavaScript, navigation remains available inline. Use TopBar for contextual application tools.
summary: Site branding and navigation with an automatic mobile drawer.

slots.brand: Site logo or home link. Remains visible at every width.
slots.navigation: Primary navigation links, authored once for desktop and mobile. Selecting a link closes the mobile drawer.
slots.actions: Optional persistent actions such as search or account controls. Supply each action directly so the header can reserve its adjustable hit area.
slots.menu: Optional custom mobile trigger for a separately owned navigation surface, such as a combined documentation sidebar. Omit this slot for the automatic drawer; supplying it replaces the automatic trigger and leaves its target and behavior to the application.
